format: Studio / Custom events: temporarily hiding a published result during an authorized correction
requirement: DanceFlow policy (not a body rule), confirmed by the owner on 2026-11-23: a published result may be temporarily hidden from entrant-facing and public results while an authorized correction is open, or after an explicit manager withdrawal with a reason. Hiding never means deletion or destructive replacement: every original result version, ballot, scoring evidence, audit record and publication row is preserved (OD-04). Completed rounds need OD-07's controlled correction authorization; the corrected result publishes as a NEW LINKED version (supersede, publication_version + 1).
enforcement_point: F3 withdraw_competition_round_result and _compf3_live() gate every non-manager reader; publish_competition_round_result supersedes.
interpretation_notes: Behavior exists and is covered by F3 SQL tests as written, but: (a) the entrant-facing reader competition_my_results simply omits a non-live publication and has no under-review indicator (only the round-level public reader returns under_review); (b) the OD-07 controlled correction authorization for completed rounds (PR 838) is design only; (c) SQL tests were not run for this docs-only entry. Not any body's rule; for body-declared events the OD-01 restriction (PR 832) still applies.
decision_refs: OD-22 (owner decision 2026-11-23: Option B for initial Studio/Custom; Option A for future WSDC support, with UCWDC correction-authority restrictions; retrospective audit PR #795)
